description: This file appears to be an entry point or front controller for the OrangeHRM system, responsible for redirecting users depending on installation status. It includes license and documentation comments, a namespace import, a vendor autoload, and a redirect based on system configuration.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that manages configuration settings for OrangeHRM, including whether the system has been installed.
